name-01.output: Lin Xiao, how come you're here so early today?
name-01.direct: Lin Xiao, why did you come so early today?
name-01.reflect: 直译准确自然，'来得这么早'在英文口语中常说 come so early / get here so early，语气是日常问候，无需调整。
name-01.free: Lin Xiao, how come you're here so early today?

context-01.output: Don't worry, I've got it memorized.
context-01.direct: Don't worry, I've already memorized it thoroughly.
context-01.reflect: 直译准确自然，'背熟了'意为记牢了，英文用 memorized it 或 got it memorized 都地道，语气轻松安慰，无需改动。
context-01.free: Don't worry, I've got it memorized.

slang-01.output: That was an insanely slick move — I'm absolutely losing it.
slang-01.direct: This wave of operation is too showy, I directly split open.
slang-01.reflect: “这波操作”是网络用语，指这一系列举动/做法；“太秀了”意为非常厉害/出彩；“我直接裂开”是夸张表达震惊到崩溃。直译字面不通，需意译出赞叹加震惊的语气。
slang-01.free: That was an insanely slick move — I'm absolutely losing it.

idiom-01.direct: This is simply drawing legs on a snake.
idiom-01.reflect: 直译保留了成语字面，但英文读者不懂这个典故，会一头雾水；英文里对应的习语是 gild the lily 或 overcomplicate things，语气上带点批评和无奈。

short-01.reflect: 原文是简单的应答词“嗯”，表示同意或回应，直译“Yeah”自然贴切，语气也符合。

corpus-01.output: Teacher, I really did my homework—but the dog ate it.
corpus-01.direct: Teacher, I really did my homework but it was eaten by the dog.
corpus-01.reflect: 直译准确，但英文里 'the dog ate my homework' 本身就是众所周知的借口梗，语气和中文完全对应，无需改动。
corpus-01.free: Teacher, I really did my homework—but the dog ate it.

corpus-02.output: That head tilt was totally you sneaking a peek at the lines!
corpus-02.direct: That tilt of the head was stealing a look at the words!
corpus-02.reflect: 直译基本传达了意思，但 'stealing a look at the words' 稍显生硬，'偷看词' 指偷看台词/提词，英文口语常说 'peeking at the lines' 或 'sneaking a peek at the script'，语气是调侃揭穿，需保留。
corpus-02.free: That head tilt was totally you sneaking a peek at the lines!

corpus-03.output: Nah, I'm not looking to date—keeping a little mystery is nice.
corpus-03.direct: Not dating, keeping a sense of mystery is pretty good.
corpus-03.reflect: “不处”是网络口语，指不处对象/不谈恋爱，直译成 not dating 准确；整句语气轻松随意，带点自我调侃，英文用口语化的说法即可。
corpus-03.free: Nah, I'm not looking to date—keeping a little mystery is nice.

corpus-04.reflect: 直译基本达意，但英文口语里表达'这么突然'更自然的说法是 'That's so sudden' 或 'So sudden?'，语气上带点惊讶和措手不及，用 'That's so sudden' 更地道。

corpus-05.output: Hahaha that's just too wild, who even gets this question?
corpus-05.direct: It's just hahaha too abstract, who understands this question?
corpus-05.reflect: 直译基本传达了意思，但'太抽象了'是网络用语，指事情离谱、难以理解，英文口语里常用 'wild' 或 'makes no sense'；'谁懂啊'是共鸣式吐槽，英文对应 'who gets it' 或 'who even understands'。整体语气是调侃吐槽，需要保留。
corpus-05.free: Hahaha that's just too wild, who even gets this question?

corpus-06.output: Looks like it's true—I even came across some fan-shot clips from his concert.
corpus-06.direct: Seems like it's true, I even scrolled to his concert's leaked on-site videos.
corpus-06.reflect: 「刷到」是刷短视频/社交平台时刷到的意思，英文自然说法是 came across / scrolled past；「路透」指粉丝或路人拍的现场非官方视频，英文常说 leaked clips 或 fan-shot footage。直译的 scrolled to 和 concert's leaked on-site videos 都生硬。
corpus-06.free: Looks like it's true—I even came across some fan-shot clips from his concert.

corpus-07.output: Which class meeting? How come I didn't hear about it?
corpus-07.direct: Which class meeting, how come I didn't hear it?
corpus-07.reflect: 直译基本准确，但'我怎么没听着'是口语化的反问，表达'我怎么不知道/没听说'，英文用 'How come I didn't hear about it?' 更自然，保留疑惑语气。
corpus-07.free: Which class meeting? How come I didn't hear about it?

corpus-08.output: Plus, his honest, good-natured vibe makes him so relatable. You're not losing out here—you might even score a free meal with that face.
corpus-08.direct: Besides, his honest and simple-minded aura is so down-to-earth and approachable. You don't lose out this time. Maybe you can even mooch a meal with this face.
corpus-08.reflect: “憨厚老实”是褒义，指人朴实可靠，直译 honest and simple-minded 中 simple-minded 在英文里偏贬义（有点傻），应改为 honest and good-natured；“亲民”指接地气、有亲和力，用 relatable/approachable；“你这波不亏”是网络口语，意为这买卖你不吃亏，用 you're not losing out here；“蹭顿饭”是白吃一顿，用 score a free meal 更地道。
corpus-08.free: Plus, his honest, good-natured vibe makes him so relatable. You're not losing out here—you might even score a free meal with that face.

corpus-09.output: Should we throw this souvenir away?
corpus-09.direct: Should this souvenir be thrown away?
corpus-09.reflect: 直译准确自然，语气是日常询问，没有梗或俗语需要处理，英文口语中这样问完全地道。
corpus-09.free: Should we throw this souvenir away?

corpus-10.output: That idea of yours is pretty out there.
corpus-10.direct: Your this idea is also abstract enough.
corpus-10.reflect: 直译生硬且'abstract'在英文里不表达'离谱/奇葩'的网络含义。'够抽象的'是网络梗，指想法离谱、莫名其妙，英文对应说法是'wild'或'out there'。
corpus-10.free: That idea of yours is pretty out there.

corpus-11.output: Fine, I'll deal with all this toxic positivity once I'm back in China.
corpus-11.direct: Alright, wait until I return to China to deal with these poisonous chicken soups.
corpus-11.reflect: "毒鸡汤" is internet slang for toxic motivational/inspirational quotes—literally "poisonous chicken soup." The literal translation would confuse English viewers; the natural equivalent is "toxic inspirational quotes" or "toxic positivity." "行" here is an agreeing/accepting "fine/alright," and "等我回国处理" means "wait till I'm back in China to handle it."
corpus-11.free: Fine, I'll deal with all this toxic positivity once I'm back in China.

corpus-12.output: So short—did you hit a creative block?
corpus-12.direct: So short, did you hit a creative bottleneck?
corpus-12.reflect: 直译准确传达了字面意思和调侃语气。'creative bottleneck' 在英文中也是常用说法，自然地道，反问语气保留。
corpus-12.free: So short—did you hit a creative block?

corpus-14.output: Your proposal vs. your colleague's PPT—which one comes out on top?
corpus-14.direct: Your proposal vs. your colleague's PPT, who is more superior?
corpus-14.reflect: 直译基本达意，但'更胜一筹'是成语，英文里用'come out on top'或'win'更自然；'vs.'在口语中可保留，但整体要更像英语母语者随口一问的对比语气。
corpus-14.free: Your proposal vs. your colleague's PPT—which one comes out on top?

corpus-15.output: Just look at that pretentiously profound expression—you know something's fishy. That kind of straight-faced nonsense is comedy gold.
corpus-15.direct: Look at that deliberately profound expression of his and you know there's a catch—this kind of deadpan nonsense has the best comedic effect.
corpus-15.reflect: 直译基本准确，但'有猫腻'译成there's a catch略生硬，更自然的是something fishy；'故作高深'用pretentiously profound更贴切；'一本正经的胡说八道'英文对应deadpan nonsense或straight-faced bullshit，口语化用deadpan nonsense；'最有喜剧效果'说is the funniest更自然。
corpus-15.free: Just look at that pretentiously profound expression—you know something's fishy. That kind of straight-faced nonsense is comedy gold.

corpus-16.output: Oh man, why didn't you say so earlier? No wonder you post sunrises on your Moments every day.
corpus-16.direct: I go—why didn't you say earlier, no wonder your Moments show off the sunrise every day.
corpus-16.reflect: 「我去」是惊讶感叹，不是字面的“I go”；「不早说」是埋怨对方没早点讲；「朋友圈」是微信朋友圈，英文常说 WeChat Moments 或直接 Moments；「晒」是炫耀/发照片，用 post/show off。整体是恍然后带点调侃抱怨的语气。
corpus-16.free: Oh man, why didn't you say so earlier? No wonder you post sunrises on your Moments every day.

corpus-17.output: Not dating. These days, love comes with a price tag.
corpus-17.direct: Not dating, these days love is all clearly priced.
corpus-17.reflect: “不处”是网络口语，意为“不谈恋爱/不处对象”；“明码标价”指爱情被标上价格、变得物质化。直译基本达意，但“clearly priced”稍显生硬，英文里“love has a price tag”更地道自然。
corpus-17.free: Not dating. These days, love comes with a price tag.

corpus-18.output: Not interested in dating. Go entertain yourself.
corpus-18.direct: Not date, go play by yourself.
corpus-18.reflect: “不处”是网络用语，指不处对象/不谈恋爱，直译“not date”生硬且歧义；“自己玩去”是打发人的口语，带不耐烦语气，英文对应“go play by yourself”可以，但整体需要更口语化地表达拒绝交往、让对方走开。
corpus-18.free: Not interested in dating. Go entertain yourself.

corpus-19.output: Look, the lottery numbers I bought are exactly the same as the ones you said yesterday.
corpus-19.direct: Look, the lottery winning numbers I bought are exactly the same as what you said yesterday.
corpus-19.reflect: 直译准确，但'你看'是口语化的提醒/强调语气，英文用'Look'自然；'中奖号码'指我买的号码中了，不是'winning numbers I bought'的歧义，应明确是我买的号码和你说的一样。整体流畅，语气是惊讶/确认。
corpus-19.free: Look, the lottery numbers I bought are exactly the same as the ones you said yesterday.

corpus-20.output: Hakimi north-south green beans — I'm holding back laughter at my desk until it hurts.
corpus-20.direct: Hakimi north-south green beans, I've held it in at my workstation until I got internal injuries.
corpus-20.reflect: "哈基米南北绿豆" is an internet meme/nonsense phrase (from a viral cat video song), not meant literally; "憋出内伤" means suppressing laughter/emotion so hard it hurts inside. Need to convey the meme vibe and the feeling of barely holding back laughter at work.
corpus-20.free: Hakimi north-south green beans — I'm holding back laughter at my desk until it hurts.

corpus-21.output: Ran into this guy on the subway who kept muttering anime lines to himself the whole ride.
corpus-21.direct: On the subway I ran into a big bro who the whole time used anime lines to talk to himself.
corpus-21.reflect: 直译基本准确，但 'big bro' 略生硬，'the whole time' 位置不自然；'大哥' 这里指陌生男子，英文用 'guy' 更自然；'动漫台词' 用 'anime lines' 可以。整体语气是吐槽/分享见闻，应保持口语化。
corpus-21.free: Ran into this guy on the subway who kept muttering anime lines to himself the whole ride.

corpus-22.output: I stayed up late last night watching your livestream and laughed so hard my stomach hurt.
corpus-22.direct: Last night I stayed up late watching your livestream and laughed until my stomach hurt.
corpus-22.reflect: 直译准确传达了意思，'笑到肚子疼'英文有对应表达 'laughed so hard my stomach hurt'，语气自然口语化，无需改动。
corpus-22.free: I stayed up late last night watching your livestream and laughed so hard my stomach hurt.

corpus-23.output: Rushed out the door and accidentally brought the rag to the office thinking it was my towel.
corpus-23.direct: In a hurry to go out, I directly took the rag as a towel to the company.
corpus-23.reflect: 直译基本准确，但 'directly took the rag as a towel' 略显生硬，'as a towel' 可改为 'thinking it was a towel' 更自然；'in a hurry to go out' 可简化为 'rushed out'，整体语气是自嘲调侃，需保留。
corpus-23.free: Rushed out the door and accidentally brought the rag to the office thinking it was my towel.

corpus-24.output: Not dating. This drama's too juicy for me to handle.
corpus-24.direct: Not dating, the melon is too big to bite through.
corpus-24.reflect: “不处”是网络用语，指不处对象/不谈恋爱；“瓜”是网络吃瓜梗，指八卦；“啃不动”指八卦太劲爆消化不了。直译会让英文观众完全看不懂。
corpus-24.free: Not dating. This drama's too juicy for me to handle.

corpus-27.output: Isn't that how it should be?
corpus-27.reflect: 直译生硬，'what should be' 不地道。原文是反问，表达'这是理所当然的'，英文常用 'Isn't that how it should be?' 或 'Isn't that a given?'，语气自然。
corpus-27.free: Isn't that how it should be?

corpus-28.output: The boss is marrying the cleaning lady.
corpus-28.direct: The boss is going to marry the cleaning auntie.
corpus-28.reflect: 直译基本准确，但'保洁阿姨'在英文里说 cleaning auntie 很别扭，应说 cleaning lady；'老板'视语境可用 boss，整体语气是陈述一件出人意料的事，英文用 is marrying 更自然。
corpus-28.free: The boss is marrying the cleaning lady.

corpus-29.output: Treadmill, elliptical, or spin bike—which is better for overweight people trying to lose fat?
corpus-29.direct: Treadmill, elliptical, and spin bike, which one is more suitable for high-body-weight fat-loss people?
corpus-29.reflect: 直译基本准确，但'大体重减脂人群'在英文中更自然的说法是'people with a high body weight who want to lose fat'或'overweight people trying to lose fat'；'动感单车'指spin bike/indoor cycling bike，'椭圆机'是elliptical。整体是疑问句，语气中性，需保持自然口语。
corpus-29.free: Treadmill, elliptical, or spin bike—which is better for overweight people trying to lose fat?

corpus-31.output: Oh man, I can't even—I'm gonna be laughing about this for a whole year. Come on, who hasn't had an embarrassing story about buying sanitary pads?
corpus-31.direct: Oh my, I can't take it anymore, this kind of experience I can laugh about for a whole year, who among everyone doesn't have a bit of a social death story about buying sanitary pads!
corpus-31.reflect: 直译基本传达了意思，但'我不行了'在口语中表示笑得受不了，'社死'是网络流行语指尴尬到社会性死亡，'谁还没点'是反问表示大家都有类似经历。英文中'laugh for a year'可以保留，'social death'在英文中也有类似用法但不够口语化，可以用'embarrassing'或'cringe-worthy'更自然。'谁还没点'可以译为'who hasn't had'保持反问语气。
corpus-31.free: Oh man, I can't even—I'm gonna be laughing about this for a whole year. Come on, who hasn't had an embarrassing story about buying sanitary pads?

corpus-32.output: I'm already running a fever—please, aunties, cut me some slack.
corpus-32.direct: I'm already running a fever, please let me go, aunties.
corpus-32.reflect: “大妈们”指爱管闲事、爱唠叨的中老年女性群体，直译 aunties 在英文里能传达这种社区大妈的形象；“放过我吧”是恳求别再纠缠，let me go 偏字面，英文更自然说 cut me some slack / leave me alone。
corpus-32.free: I'm already running a fever—please, aunties, cut me some slack.

corpus-33.output: Watch Gen Z chat in Martian text
corpus-33.direct: Watch post-00s chat in Martian language
corpus-33.reflect: “火星文”指中国网络早期那种用符号、生僻字、谐音拼凑的难懂文字，英文里对应的是 leetspeak / textspeak 这类网络黑话，直译 Martian language 英文观众也能懂梗；'00后' 说成 Gen Z 更地道。
corpus-33.free: Watch Gen Z chat in Martian text

corpus-34.free: I keep getting interrupted by messages at work and find it hard to focus. Any tips for improving efficiency?

corpus-38.output: I was scrolling through videos and saw a Shandong auntie selling a huge jianbing guozi, and suddenly I wondered—is Shandong jianbing the biggest in all of China?

corpus-38.free: I was scrolling through videos and saw a Shandong auntie selling a huge jianbing guozi, and suddenly I wondered—is Shandong jianbing the biggest in all of China?

corpus-39.free: Its 9.4 rating on Douban also proves its quality.

corpus-41.direct: Others: white-browed tiger with upward-slanting eyes. Me: Qiaolezi ice cream.
corpus-41.reflect: “吊睛白额虎”是《水浒传》里形容猛虎的固定说法（白额吊睛的老虎），直译成 white-browed tiger with upward-slanting eyes 太生硬，英文观众会一头雾水；这里是在对比“别人很猛/很凶，我却很软萌/很甜”，巧乐兹是巧克力脆皮雪糕品牌，保留拼音即可。

corpus-42.free: Hahaha I can't even, netizens these days are just too creative.
